people.imagined: Dawn at the plum gate, snow falling. A visitor has arrived and the old founder looks first at the visitor's hands, not the face, then slowly lifts his eyes. He is barefoot in the snow as always, his cloak white felt with an iron-thread branch.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn in falling snow he lowers his gaze to the viewer's hands, eyes dropped and head slightly bowed, then begins to lift them. Face: most important, his cheeks and nose are frost-burned, a raw, shiny, mottled pink-red and white patch across both cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, plainly visible. A lean, hard, bony old man's face; deep-set pale grey eyes, flat and unyielding; heavy grey brows; a long hooked nose; a thin hard mouth; a short grey beard cropped to the jaw. Hair: iron-grey, long, tied in a hard topknot with a dark plum-wood pin bearing three pink blossoms, under a slim silver crown worked with plum flowers. Body: lean, upright, narrow-hipped, hard as a rail. Clothing: the founder's richest dress: a white gauze over-robe that drifts like snow over layered white silk with three crossed collars edged in pale pink plum embroidery, a wide white sash, a long cloak of white felt-silk with a plum branch stitched across the shoulder in dark iron thread; wide sleeves, no jewellery but the crown and pin; barefoot in the snow. Hands and objects: his right hand rests on the grip of a plain grey sword at his left hip, the blade tiger-stripe iron with one small plum blossom etched near the hilt; the hand lean and knotted. Power: a pale green-white aura of living wood and silver metal motes drifts about him with the snow, and the falling flakes swerve around his shoulders. Background: soft white falling snow in mist, a black plum tree trunk with a few pink flowers, blurred. Light: pale silver dawn glow, snow-bright, with a cool rim along the white gauze. Expression: cold, assessing, unforgiving and still.

people.imagined: The old smelting house, forge-light. He stands short and enormous in a striped tiger-hide coat, forearms like ore, quietly hammering. Thick, calm, he does not hurry. He tanned the hide of the tiger that killed his brother's daughter.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the forge with a hammer resting on his shoulder, he looks at the viewer with calm, heavy-lidded patience, the glow of the fire on his face. Face: most important, a short, enormous man in a coat of orange-and-black tiger hide with the stripes clearly visible, the collar high and furry about his neck, worn over his white silks. A broad, square, flat-nosed face, ruddy brown; small, calm, deep-set dark eyes; heavy brows; a thick neck; a wide, mild mouth; a short black beard dusted with iron grey. Hair: short black, cut straight across, a white silk band tied round the brow, a plum-wood pin with two blossoms. Body: short, extremely broad, barrel chest, forearms like logs, enormous hands. Clothing: the striped tiger-hide coat open at the chest over white silk in two crossed collars with pale pink plum borders, a wide white sash gone grey with ash; the wide sleeves cut away at the elbow, the bare forearms big as the mountain's ore, marked with small burn scars. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a heavy smith's hammer, head up at the shoulder; the left holds a long grey sword blank with a faint orange glow. Power: a slow drift of silver metal motes rises from the blank like sparks that do not fall. Background: the orange mouth of a forge in a stone smelting house, sparks, blurred, thin smoke. Light: strong orange firelight from the front and right, a silver gleam along the blank. Expression: heavy lids, a calm, slow gaze and a broad, still face lit by the fire, the mouth flat and unhurried.

people.imagined: The training yard in sleet, late afternoon. She has just sent a girl off to train barefoot until dark rather than answer. Her hand goes to the long white scar on her neck, then drops. She wants a master past Trúc Cơ and knows the school cannot give one.
people.subject: The moment: in a snowy training yard she stands tall with her chin raised, a hand just lowering from her throat, her gaze steady and shut-in. Face: most important, a long white scar from a tiger's claw runs down the left side of her neck from the jaw to the collar, four parallel raised lines, bright against the brown skin. A tall woman's long, strong, handsome face; high cheekbones; steady dark eyes under straight, strong brows; a long straight nose; a firm, closed mouth; a weaver's-daughter patience in the set of the face. Hair: black, with a few grey threads at the temple, pulled back into a high tight knot pinned with a dark plum-branch pin with two pink blossoms. Body: tall, straight, strong shoulders, a swordswoman's stillness. Clothing: flowing white silk in three crossed collars, the lowest cut low enough to show the scar, the collars edged with pale pink plum-branch embroidery; a wide white sash with a silver clasp; a thin white gauze over-robe lifting at the hem in the sleet; wide sleeves; no jewellery but the pin. Hands and objects: her right hand just lowering from her neck, long fingers; a plain sword in a grey scabbard held upright in her left. Power: fine silver metal motes and a few pale green wisps circle the scabbard, quiet and controlled. Background: falling sleet, a white yard, a dark wall of pine, mist, blurred. Light: pale silver light, sleet-bright, a soft cold rim on her cheek. Expression: composed, patient, held-in hunger.

people.imagined: Sleet at the plum gate, a child in front of him. He sniffs the sky before he speaks, a twig of plum tucked behind one ear. He keeps no record of the ones he turned away.
people.subject: The moment: at a garden gate in sleet he lifts his nose and sniffs the sky with half-closed eyes, deciding the weather before he decides the child. Face: most important, a thin plum twig with three small white blossoms is tucked behind his right ear, clearly seen against the grey hair. A thin, long, weather-beaten face, brown and cracked; half-closed dark eyes; heavy lids; a long nose lifted; a thin mouth turned down; a sparse grey beard, the cheeks cracked with cold and a fine rime of ice in the stubble along the jaw. Hair: grey, tied up high with a wooden pin. Body: tall, lean, upright, a gate-keeper's stillness. Clothing: flowing white silk in three crossed collars, the collars edged in pale pink plum embroidery, a wide white sash, a grey silk scarf at the neck, a small plum-branch pin at the collar; a white gauze over-robe beading with sleet. Hands and objects: his right hand lifted to shield sleet from his brow; his left holds the post of a gate of plain black wood. A small woven basket of plum twigs hangs from his sash, and on the gate post hangs a thin bronze bell without a clapper. A straight double-edged sword, its grip wrapped in undyed white cord, a plain guard of pale steel, an unlacquered scabbard of bare plum-wood rubbed smooth, a tiny cut twig of plum tied at the pommel, is slung diagonally across his back, the hilt showing above the left shoulder. Power: a thin pale-green and silver shimmer settles on the gate's branches. Background: a gate arch of dark branches, a few plum trees showing pink blossom through the sleet like ink dots. Light: flat pale silver light from above, a soft glow in the blossoms. Expression: arbitrary, distant, deciding, unfeeling.

people.imagined: The frozen tailings ice at dawn, inner-gate test. He sits with his left foot a hand's width forward, sword across his knees, waiting. His lip splits from frost every winter. He lost to the founder in two petals and has been grateful ever since.
people.subject: The moment: seated on the ice at dawn he waits for a candidate, a sword across his knees, his chin tipped. Face: most important, his lower lip is split down the middle by a deep red frost crack, dark rust-red at the centre and rimmed with dry white skin, plainly visible. A hard, scarred, brown face with high cheekbones, heavy jaw; deep-set, steady dark eyes; thick grey brows; a broken nose; short grey stubble stiff with frozen breath; the look of a man who has seen all his duels. Hair: iron grey, cropped short, a white silk band round the brow. Body: broad, solid, seated square, the left foot set forward. Clothing: an elder's dress: layered white silk with three crossed collars edged in pale pink plum embroidery, a wide white sash, a white gauze over-robe drifting like snow, a silver circlet worked with plum blossoms; sleeves tied back; a grey silk scarf tucked in at the neck; bare feet red with cold on the ice, though the hem is perfectly clean. Hands and objects: a plain sword in a grey scabbard lying across his knees, both hands resting on it, the knuckles scarred. Power: a faint ring of pale green-white frost-light and silver motes lies on the ice around him, stronger than the cold. Background: a frozen white plain of ore tailings in rose mist, a few dark pines, a line of waiting candidates small and blurred at the far end with their swords held downward. Light: cold pink-grey dawn glow, a pale rim along the gauze. Expression: a stern, tipped chin and a steady, unblinking gaze, lips thin and dry with a frost-split crack, his face set and patient.

people.imagined: The forge boy at the bellows, sooty, ears out. He holds up his scalded left palm without complaint. One shoulder is higher than the other. He is content and humble; his family mined this town.
people.subject: The moment: at the bellows with soot on his face, he looks up and shows a shiny scalded palm without complaining, a patient little smile. Face: most important, a soot-black face with two big ears that stick out sideways, pale pink through the grime. A thin, young, narrow face; a long nose; wide-set, mild brown eyes, bright and quick behind the black; thin brows; a small, kind mouth; a smear of soot from the left ear across the jaw. Hair: black, sooty, cropped short, a white cord tied round the head. Body: thin, one shoulder visibly higher than the other from the bellows, the left a full hand higher than the right, the neck bending the other way to balance it. Clothing: the simplest graceful white silk of an outer disciple in a crossed collar with a thread of pale pink plum embroidery, soot-stained at the cuffs and front but whole and well made; sleeves rolled; a grey silk sash tied up with rope; the hem stained grey with forge ash. A mended seam shows on the left sleeve. Hands and objects: his left palm held toward the viewer, the skin shiny, tight and glossy pink as from scalds; his right hand on a long wooden bellows handle. Background: the orange glow of a forge in a dark stone hall, sparks, drifting smoke. Light: orange firelight from the right and below, lighting the underside of his ears so they seem to glow pink at the edges, a faint silver rim on his hair. Expression: a small, patient smile with sooty cheeks, his eyes lifted and mild as he holds out the scalded palm without a wince.

people.imagined: Beside the quench trough, steam rising. He holds a freshly forged blade and smirks, his thick neck bulging, watching someone else's hand over the steam. He thinks he should be the smith's heir.
people.subject: The moment: beside a quenching trough he lifts a blade from steaming water and grins, a heavy sneer, as if pleased by someone's pain. Face: most important, a neck as thick as a post, the muscles bulging, and forearms spotted with small round pale scald scars. A broad, thick, red face; small, bright, hard eyes shiny as if he has just tasted something sweet; thick brows; a big nose; a wide thin-lipped mouth in a long smirk, the grin held too long, the lips wet. Hair: black, cut short at the back, an oiled topknot held by a bright bronze pin set with a small red stone, richer than the school allows. Body: very thick-necked, heavy-shouldered. Clothing: white silk of fine make, spotless at the collar, with two crossed collars edged in pale pink plum borders and a wide white sash; a thin gold chain showing at the neck; sleeves rolled to show the forearms; a plum-wood pin on the collar. Hands and objects: a long grey freshly quenched sword blade held up in the right hand, steam curling off it; the left forearm bare and speckled with small shiny scald scars. Power: a cold silver gleam of metal qi runs along the blade, and the steam curls into faint shapes around it. Background: clouds of white steam in a dim forge hall, a dark trough, behind him on its edge a younger smith's boy blurred, holding his own left palm tight to his chest. Light: orange from the right and white steam glow, silver rim on the blade. Expression: a heavy, sneering grin with his chin pushed forward, eyes bright and gloating, the thick neck swelling.

people.imagined: Inside an old mine shaft with a tin lamp. She squints, keeping the miner's squint in daylight too. She has picked up a lump of ore and hides it quickly toward her chest. A locked tin is under her bunk at home.
people.subject: The moment: in a dark mine shaft she holds a small lamp up with one hand and a lump of dull ore close to her chest with the other, squinting narrowly. Face: most important, soot is worked into every line of her face, dark grey in the creases, and she squints with a miner's habit, eyes mere slits. A narrow, lined, weathered face; heavy lids; thin dark brows; a long nose with a soot smudge; thin pursed lips. Hair: black, tied in a tight bun under a grey silk cloth, a few grey strands at the temple, soot lining the parting. Body: small, wiry, a little bent, shoulders rolled forward from years in low shafts, knees slightly bent as if the roof were still close above her. Clothing: white silk in two crossed collars edged with faded pink plum thread, whole but dusted with grey rock powder, a wide white sash, sleeves tied back, a slim leather strap across the chest carrying the lamp. Hands and objects: a small tin lamp with a yellow flame in the left hand; the right clutches a lump of dark grey-brown ore against her chest, a faint tiger-stripe pattern on it. Power: faint silver and ochre motes drift toward the ore from the seam as if drawn to it. Background: a dark rough rock wall with a seam of pale ore glinting like silver thread, timber props, one cracked prop leaning, a thin trickle of water shining on the floor. Light: yellow lamp light from the lower left, a pale shimmer in the seam, deep darkness around. Expression: patient, covetous, secretive.

people.imagined: At the mine mouth in daylight; his eyes are slow to take it. He wears a tin lamp-cap tied under his chin. He taps a stone with a small hammer to hear the iron.
people.subject: The moment: at the mouth of a mine in daylight he squints, blinking slowly, a small hammer raised to tap a stone he holds to his ear. Face: most important, a dented tin lamp-cap with a small lamp on the front is tied under his chin by a cloth strap, plainly in view, a bar of daylight lighting the dents in its tin. A thin, pale, narrow, shy young face with large dark eyes blinking in the light, the pupils huge; light brows; a small nose; a closed, quiet mouth. Hair: black, mostly hidden by the tin cap, a few wisps over the ears. Body: thin and slightly hunched, narrow shoulders; the left shoulder droops under the weight of a coil of rope and a satchel of sample ore, his hands long and loose. Clothing: the simplest graceful white silk of an outer disciple, a crossed collar with a thread of pale pink plum embroidery, dusted with grey from the rock; a strap across the chest; sleeves tied back, each cuff cinched with a bit of cord against the cold; a short plain over-vest of oiled silk, kept clean. Hands and objects: a small iron hammer in the right hand, raised; a dark lump of rock in the left held to the ear, as he listens for the iron in it. Power: a very faint silver glint gathers in the rock at his ear. Background: the black arch of the mine behind him, daylight bright on a snowy slope, blurred, with soft mist. Light: bright pale silver daylight from the left, the dim of the shaft at his back. Expression: quiet and listening, cautious, a shy attention turned inward.

people.imagined: On the tailings ice after a bout. A plum-petal-shaped bruise on her cheek, which she says she earned. She wants to reach the fifth petal before Cung Hàn Nhạn. She has copied the drill notes for the other side.
people.subject: The moment: on a frozen plain after a bout she stands with a sword point down and lifts her chin proudly, one cheek marked. Face: most important, a plum-petal-shaped bruise, a rounded purple-and-yellow patch the size of a coin, five-lobed, purple at the centre and yellow at the edge, on her left cheek; a tiny scab sits at the corner of her lip. A narrow, sharp, fair face; bright, hard, green-brown eyes; high thin brows; a thin straight nose; a mouth set in a hard proud line; a slight flush. Hair: black, tied in a high ponytail with a white silk cord and a small plum-wood pin. Body: slender, tall for her years, shoulders back. Clothing: fine, clean white silk in two crossed collars edged in pale pink plum embroidery, a wide white sash, a small plum-branch pin at the collar; a fine grey silk scarf wound at the neck with its tail tucked in the sash; the white sleeves tied back at the elbow with cord. Hands and objects: both hands on the pommel of a plain sword whose point rests on the ice, the blade grey; her knuckles reddened with cold. Power: thin silver wisps of metal qi trail from the blade tip into the ice. Background: a white frozen plain in pale mist, a grey sky, dark pines far off, and in the distance a second figure, tall and still, practising thrusts in the same ice yard, out of focus. Light: cold bright silver light from the left with a pale rim along her jaw. Expression: chin lifted with a proud, hot-eyed look, jaw tight, and the bruised cheek turned toward the viewer as if it were a medal.

people.imagined: Dusk in the yard. Sent to train barefoot until dark, she has chopped off her braid at the nape. She is lying to Ân Lãnh Phong. Her eyes are quick.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk in a snowy yard she turns her head quickly over her shoulder, wary, a lie already on her tongue, showing the cut line of her hair at the nape. Face: most important, her black hair is hacked off at the nape just below the ears, in uneven tufts with a short braid-stub, plain to see. A clever, narrow, sharp face with quick, dark, watchful eyes, thin arched brows, a straight nose and a small, tight, slightly crooked smile; a thin red line from a training scrape runs along her jaw, and her left ear has a faint nick in its rim. Hair: black, chopped short and uneven, the ends stiff where she cut them with a blade. Body: wiry, quick and tense, weight on the balls of her feet, shoulders half turned, one heel lifted to run or strike. Clothing: clean, fine white silk with two crossed collars and a belt, pale pink plum embroidery along the collar, a plum-branch pin; her bare feet, sent out to train barefoot until dark, show horn-hard at the lower frame edge on the packed snow, grey with cold, the hem stiff with frost. Hands and objects: her right hand holds a plain sword down in a quiet grip; the left hangs at her side, fingers curled. Power: a few silver motes spin tight around the sword's edge, nervous like her. Background: a darkening yard with a stack of firewood, blue dusk, snow mist, blurred. Light: cool blue dusk glow from the left, catching the cut line of her hair and a pale rim along her cheekbone. Expression: clever and wary, a tight half-smile that has been rehearsed.

people.imagined: In the snow, proud, copying the founder's stance exactly. He shows the frostbite blisters on his heels with pleasure. He means to duel the Pines' best before thirty.
people.subject: The moment: standing in the snow in a copy of an older man's stance, one hand on a sword hilt, chin raised, grin proud. Face: most important, a deliberate copy of the founder's look, a hard, stern face with a frosted-red nose and cheeks, though still boyish and round at the jaw; frostbite blisters show on his bare heels at the bottom of the frame and he is pleased with them. Small, bright, grey-brown eyes narrowed in imitation; heavy dark brows drawn down; a short straight nose, red at the tip; a firm mouth held hard, close to a grin; lips chapped and split at the corners; a few pale hairs on the upper lip. Hair: black, in a tight topknot with a plain wooden pin. Body: lean, straight, shoulders pushed back. Clothing: clean white silk in two crossed collars with pale pink plum borders, a wide white sash, a short white cloak of felt-silk over the shoulders, a plum-branch pin. Hands and objects: the right hand on the grip of a plain sword at his side; the left in a fist at his hip. Power: a thin pale-green and silver shimmer, as if the snow rises to him, a little more than a young disciple should carry. Background: snow in soft mist, a few dark plum branches, a pale sky; behind him a line of his own bare footprints runs back across fresh snow, deep and straight, and a pale sun hangs low. Light: bright cold silver light from the left, lighting the frost on his lashes and the snow-crystals on the cloak. Expression: proud, show-off, stern and absurdly serious.

people.imagined: Dawn on the frozen tailings. She practises the five petals, calm and patient, the pearl-grey sash kept spotless. The weaver's calluses show across her right palm. She does not hurry.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn on the ice she holds a sword in a still guard, mid-practice, calm. Face: most important, a pearl-grey silk sash tied at the waist is perfectly clean and bright against the white robe, and the palm of her sword hand is crossed by hard calluses in rows, as a weaver's. A calm, oval, fair face; steady, clear grey eyes; level, fine brows; a small straight nose; a quiet closed mouth, rosy with the cold; a fine trace of frost on the lashes, the tips of her ears pink, her breath hanging as a small cloud. Hair: black, in one smooth braid coiled at the nape with a white cord and a single plain pin of pale wood, the hairline smooth without a loose strand. Body: slender, balanced, a stillness of stance. Clothing: finely woven white silk in two crossed collars edged with pale pink plum embroidery; the pearl-grey sash at the waist, spotless, its long ends floating; a small plum pin; wide sleeves falling in clean folds. Hands and objects: her right hand holds a plain sword upright, the calloused palm turned to the viewer; the left steadies the wrist. Power: thin trails of silver and pale green light follow the blade's path in the air. Background: pale pink dawn on a frozen plain, mist, dark pines; behind her five shallow circles are marked in the snow in a ring, each with a single footprint, the pattern of the five petals. Light: soft pink-grey dawn glow from the left, a silver rim on the sash. Expression: a calm, still face, eyes lowered along the blade, mouth relaxed and closed, with the patient look of someone not in a hurry.

people.imagined: Under the grave plums. A crack in the branches startles her. A flat locket with a pressed petal is open in her hand. She thinks of her friend who failed the gate.
people.subject: The moment: standing under bare plum branches she starts at a sound, one hand clasped to a small round locket at her chest, eyes wide. Face: a soft, round, tender young face, flushed with cold; large, startled, dark brown eyes; thin high brows; a small nose; a small open mouth; a beauty spot under one eye. Hair: dark brown, in two low plaits tied with white silk cord, a plum-wood pin with one pink blossom. Body: small, slight, shoulders drawn up toward her ears, weight on the back foot as if she might step back. Clothing: the simplest graceful white silk of an outer disciple, two crossed collars with pale pink plum embroidery, a belt of white silk, a plum-wood pin with one pink blossom at the collar; wide soft sleeves. Hands and objects: a small round brass locket opened in her right hand, a single flat pink plum petal pressed inside it, clear and bright; her left hand at her throat. Slung across the back, the hilt of a short slim sword rises past the left shoulder, in a green-stained scabbard, the grip wrapped in bark-brown cord, a dark wood guard. Power: a few pale-green motes of wood qi float down with the petals around her. Background: bare black plum branches with a few pink blossoms against a pale sky; a line of folded paper letters pinned on a pine trunk with thorns, the snow beneath dotted with fallen petals, blurred. Light: soft pale moon-white glow from the left, a ray finding the brass locket and making it gleam. Expression: startled, tender and anxious.

people.imagined: Among the thick grave plums in the afternoon. He walks as if on ice and holds a pruning knife he never uses. His chilblains reach to the knee. The grave plums are a thicket.
people.subject: The moment: standing amid a thicket of overgrown plum trees he carries a small pruning knife loosely, shuffling gently, with a mild half-smile. Face: a mild, sleepy, round face, cheeks chilblain-pink with cold; half-closed, kind brown eyes with very long light lashes; soft, thin brows; a snub nose; a calm closed mouth with a trace of smile; his ears red and swollen at the rims from chilblains. Hair: brown, messy, a plum blossom caught in it. Body: soft, slouched, loose-shouldered; he steps with small careful half-steps, knees soft and toes pointed out, as if the ground might crack. Clothing: clean white silk in two crossed collars edged with pale pink plum embroidery, long sleeves, a plum-branch pin, a grey silk scarf; faint chilblain red at the wrists; just below the robe the knees of his trousers are wrapped in strips of cloth against the chilblains. Hands and objects: a small, bright, never-used pruning knife in the right hand, held low and loosely; the left hand touches a plum branch gently. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder, rises the hilt of a plain short slim sword, its grip wrapped in coarse undyed hemp with a single dried plum petal sewn under the wrap, a small oval guard of grey steel, a scabbard of unfinished pale wood bound at the mouth with a twist of grafting raffia. Power: soft pale-green motes of wood qi drift up from the branches. Background: a tangled thicket of plum branches thick with pale pink blossom, snow on the ground scattered with fallen petals and a thin trail of footprints running back among the trunks. Light: soft pale glow from the left, a pink glow from the blossoms. Expression: sleepy, content and gentle.

people.imagined: In a queue for his fines, restless, shifting from foot to foot. A fresh cut under one eye, a crooked grin. He wrecked a pie stall last time. He cannot stand still.
people.subject: The moment: shifting restlessly in a queue, he leans toward the viewer with a crooked grin and a fresh red cut beneath one eye. Face: most important, a fresh cut with scabbing under his left eye, red and plain, with a slight bruise, and a wide crooked grin with a chipped tooth. A rough, broad, sunburnt face; bright, restless, dark brown eyes; heavy, uneven brows; a nose bent a little left; a split in the lip; a line of old pale scars across the left brow and a smear of dark dried crust at the corner of his lip. Hair: black, spiky, a red cord round the head. Body: wiry, jittery, always about to move. Clothing: white silk in two crossed collars edged in pale pink plum embroidery, a wide white sash, sleeves rolled up, scuffed at one cuff; the cuff of one sleeve is split and stitched with red thread, and the white hem is spattered brown from a pie-seller's gravy. Hands and objects: a plain sword held low in the right hand, tapping the flat on his thigh; the left hand fidgets with his sash. Power: restless silver sparks of metal qi jump off the sword's flat with each tap. Background: a blurred line of waiting people in pale mist, a wooden desk at the head of the queue with a seated warden and a pile of fine slips, a bored line of figures shuffling in the grey light. Light: bright silver-white glow from the left, a faint rim on the split lip. Expression: restless, grinning, spoiling for a fight.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder's daughter in spring 1162, climbing the mountain road to the emptied ore town to see if the tiger had gone. A short sword on her back like a school satchel. Brave and impatient.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, of a young woman on a mountain road in spring, glancing up the road with brave, bright eyes, a short sword worn across her back on a strap like a school satchel. Face: most important, her father's frost-burned cheeks, a raw, pink-red mottled patch across both cheekbones and nose, with a few fine freckles beneath it. A young, round, lively face; bright, brave dark eyes with lashes wet with melted snow; strong straight brows; a short nose; a wide, quick mouth in a small impatient smile. Hair: black, in a high ponytail with a white silk cord and a single plum blossom, a short loose lock curling at each temple. Body: young, slim, quick on her feet. Clothing: finely woven white silk in two crossed collars edged with pale pink plum embroidery, a wide white sash knotted in a bow, a short grey gauze cloak over the shoulders; no shoes. Hands and objects: her right hand on the strap of the short sword across her chest; the hilt rises over her left shoulder. Power: a faint, almost lost shimmer of pale green motes in the old paint. Background: a wash of pale grey and white, the outline of a winding road climbing between black plum trunks toward a distant mountain, faded. Light: faint, even and pale, as if from old silk. Expression: bright, brave eyes glancing up the road, a quick half-smile, brows lifted, her whole body leaning into the climb.
